verdict.rationale: The evidence shows scene-level revision in Video Agent videos: named scenes are regenerated and untouched scenes are kept. That is an adjacent capability, not replacing or restyling an element inside a frame while the rest of that frame stays intact. Lip-sync dubbing and visual-style selection belong to other stories, and nothing documents in-frame object replacement, inpainting or localized restyling of existing footage.

support.subject: As a creator, I can replace or restyle an element inside an existing video while the rest of the frame stays intact
